surfaces-app.doc: Background of the whole application window; the bottom layer every other surface sits on. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-panel1.doc: Background of panels laid directly on `surfaces/app` (sidebars, cards, toolbars); first layer of the surface stack. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-panel1-hover.doc: Hover background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel1`. Panels rarely have a hover state; use only when a panel-colored element is interactive. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-panel1-selected.doc: Selected background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel1`. Panels rarely have a selected state; use only when a panel-colored element can be selected. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-panel2.doc: Background of panels nested inside `surfaces/panel1` (or placed directly on `surfaces/app`); second layer of the surface stack. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-panel2-hover.doc: Hover background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel2`. Panels rarely have a hover state; use only when a panel-colored element is interactive. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-panel2-selected.doc: Selected background for an element resting on `surfaces/panel2`. Panels rarely have a selected state; use only when a panel-colored element can be selected. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-overlay.doc: Background of elements floating above the whole app: dialogs, popovers, menus, tooltips, notifications. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-text.doc: Main text color on every surface of the set. Meets WCAG AAA against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Monochrome icons use it too (or `textMuted` when they should be muted). Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-text-muted.doc: Secondary, muted text color on every surface of the set. Meets WCAG AAA where possible and at least WCAG AA. Monochrome icons use it when they should recede. Aliases the surface set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-text-subtle.doc: Faintest text color over `bg`, `bgHover` and `bgSelected`: placeholders, hints and captions. Roughly 3 to 4:1 contrast, below WCAG AA in some roles, so never use it for essential text. Aliases the role set the current theme mode selects.

surfaces-alternate-row-bg.doc: Background of every second row in tables, lists, trees and property grids. Translucent, so it works on any surface (panel1, panel2, overlay); the row itself has no background. Hover and selected rows use the neutral element backgrounds.

surfaces-link.doc: Text color of inline links and link-style buttons at rest.

surfaces-link-hover.doc: Text color of links while hovered.

surfaces-border.doc: Main border color of components, on any surface or fill: inputs, outlined buttons, toggles, checkboxes and radios. Translucent black (light) / white (dark), so it composites onto whichever background it sits on, colored fills included.

surfaces-border-muted.doc: Muted border color for surfaces and dividers: panels, overlays, cards, tables, separators, the window edge and outlines that should recede. Translucent black (light) / white (dark), so it composites onto whichever background it sits on.

surfaces-text-danger.doc: Danger text and icons drawn directly on a surface: destructive menu items, field error messages, negative values. At least WCAG AA (5.9:1 Light, 8:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on a danger fill uses `roles/danger/text`. The same in every accent.

surfaces-text-success.doc: Success text and icons drawn directly on a surface: positive values, success messages, valid-field hints. At least WCAG AA (4.6:1 Light, 10:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on a success fill uses `roles/success/text`. The same in every accent.

surfaces-scrim.doc: Backdrop behind modal overlays (Dialog, AlertDialog, Sheet): a translucent black layer between the app and the overlay that dims the content below. The same in every accent.

surfaces-text-info.doc: Informational text and icons drawn directly on a surface: outlined info tags, notes, hints that carry information. At least WCAG AA (6.2:1 Light, 8.4:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on an info fill uses `roles/alerts/info/text`. The same in every accent.

surfaces-text-warning.doc: Warning text and icons drawn directly on a surface: outlined warning tags, cautions, values near a limit. At least WCAG AA (4.6:1 Light, 10.5:1 Dark) against `surfaces/app`, `surfaces/panel1`, `surfaces/panel2` and `surfaces/overlay`. Text on a warning fill uses `roles/alerts/warning/text`. The same in every accent.

surfaces-on-media.doc: Text and icons drawn over pictures and video, such as the Video control bar on `surfaces/scrim`: white in both color modes, because the media below stays the same in Light and Dark. The same in every accent.

interaction-caret.doc: Blinking text cursor in editable fields (inputs, number fields, OTP fields, text areas, code editor).

interaction-text-selection-fg.doc: Text color of selected text inside editable fields; sits on `textSelectionBg`.

interaction-text-selection-bg.doc: Highlight behind selected text inside editable fields. Follows the theme accent.

spacing-gap1.doc: Layout gap step 1 of 8, between tightly related components. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

spacing-gap3.doc: Layout gap step 3 of 8, between form rows. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

spacing-gap4.doc: Layout gap step 4 of 8, between form rows and small groups. For gaps between components and blocks, not inside a component (use elements/<size>/sizes/hgap* for that).

spacing-size-small-lvl1-height.doc: Level 1: height of thin indicators (progress bars, meters, slider tracks), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl1-inset.doc: Level 1: left and right inset of indicators (progress bar, slider track, badge dot), small size. An indicator holds no content, so this is half of lvl2/inset, rounded up to the grid of 2.

spacing-size-small-lvl1-inner-height.doc: Level 1: height of the nested inner element in indicators (progress bar, slider track, badge dot), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl1-inner-inset.doc: Level 1: inset between the outer edge and the inner element (height = innerHeight + 2 x innerInset) in indicators (progress bar, slider track, badge dot), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl1-adornment-size.doc: Level 1: adornment size (icons and slot content) in indicators (progress bar, slider track, badge dot), small size. An indicator has no glyph; this equals innerHeight.

spacing-size-small-lvl2-height.doc: Level 2: height of selection marks and tiny glyph controls (checkbox, radio, count badge, close button), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl2-inset.doc: Level 2: left and right inset of selection marks and tiny glyph controls (checkbox, radio, count badge, close button), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl2-inner-height.doc: Level 2: height of the nested inner element (thumb, segment, check) in selection marks and tiny glyph controls (checkbox, radio, count badge, close button), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl2-inner-inset.doc: Level 2: inset between the outer edge and the inner element (height = innerHeight + 2 x innerInset) in selection marks and tiny glyph controls (checkbox, radio, count badge, close button), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl2-adornment-size.doc: Level 2: adornment size (icons and slot content) in selection marks and tiny glyph controls (checkbox check, radio dot, count badge, close button), small size. Fits inside innerHeight with 1 px on each side.

spacing-size-small-lvl3-height.doc: Level 3: height of switches, slider thumbs and small pills, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl3-inset.doc: Level 3: left and right inset of switches, slider thumbs and small pills, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl3-inner-height.doc: Level 3: height of the nested inner element (thumb, segment, check) in switches, slider thumbs and small pills, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl3-inner-inset.doc: Level 3: inset between the outer edge and the inner element (height = innerHeight + 2 x innerInset) in switches, slider thumbs and small pills, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl3-adornment-size.doc: Level 3: adornment size (icons and slot content) in switches, slider thumbs and small pills, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl4-height.doc: Level 4: height of tags, kbd and inline chips, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl4-inset.doc: Level 4: left and right inset of tags, kbd and inline chips, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl4-inner-height.doc: Level 4: height of the nested inner element in tags, kbd and inline chips, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl4-inner-inset.doc: Level 4: inset between the outer edge and the inner element (height = innerHeight + 2 x innerInset) in tags, kbd and inline chips, small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl4-adornment-size.doc: Level 4: adornment size (icons and slot content) in tags, kbd and inline chips, small size. Equals min(line height of text/title2Regular, innerHeight - 4).

spacing-size-small-lvl5-height.doc: Level 5: height of interactive controls (buttons, fields, selects, tabs, chips, segmented controls), small size.

spacing-size-small-lvl5-inset.doc: Level 5: left and right inset of interactive controls (buttons, fields, selects, tabs, chips, segmented controls), small size.
